title: Docker
lede: Docker is repositioning around AI agents, arguing they are actors rather than workloads, and adds a sandbox runtime, a governance layer and a curated supply chain alongside a new brand.

points: Docker Sandboxes run agents such as Claude Code and Codex inside MicroVMs, on a laptop or in the cloud.
Sandboxed agents get networking that is denied by default.
Docker AI Governance lets an organisation define sandbox, network and MCP policy once and apply it on every machine.
A trusted supply chain gives agents vetted components to build from.
The launch also brings a redesigned brand and Moby whale, which commenters liked and disliked in equal measure.

sections.text: Developers and teams running coding agents unattended who want them isolated from the host machine and governed by shared policy.
